ValidationRule.description: Prevents an accepted offer from having a joining date before its response date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Accepted"), NOT(ISBLANK(Joining_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Response_Date__c)), Joining_Date__c < Response_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Joining Date cannot be before the acceptance Response Date.
